full_page.content:
1946, October 25th
Page 2
Mr. and Mrs. - Joe and Win O'Donnell
Several years ago and frequently later on, I was assured that one of the great factors in the financial success of "old-man Rockefellow" was often attributed to his having kept a promise to spend something like 10% of his profits to one or other charitable work. I am quite inclined to take stock in such a report. I have seen the like work out in other cases.
Plese pardon my prolongation of this conclusion. I meant to close in just a line or two here.
With best wishes and God's blessing to all our friends in Chicago, I beg to remain
Sincerely Yours in Christ, Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
November 8th.
Just another case of: "The more hury the less speed".
God help us. I was just looking for something else - a copy of that letter I was writing to the big policeman, MeClellan of Detr't and that I wanted to "point up a little" - and I find two of the above and bothe marked "copy". So I must conclude that you never received either.
I need no further excuse for tardiness this time - and perhaps more to be regretted of something less or more regrettable ?!?!? Thank the dear Lord for mistaks too. And thank Him that its not ten-times worse. Possibly the delay may to havebeen a salutary one. Please God it may not be other.
God bless you each and all agan Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
